acceptance_criteria.criterion: a review-finding fix proceeds to a valid review opportunity and terminal readiness/advisory state without manual review-request rebuilding
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The authorized-writer pre-commit finalizer now automatically refreshes a governed candidate's committed review request from its own claims whenever the staged content no longer matches it (scripts/hunter_writer_commit_finalizer.py), and bounded recovery for a failed post-push Governance Reconcile re-mints the exact-head request through the same existing finalizer (scripts/hunter_reconcile_recovery.py). Focused regressions cover remediation refresh, governing-Issue binding, exact staged-content binding, and absence of fabricated review authority (tests/test_hunter_writer_commit_finalizer.py, tests/test_hunter_reconcile_recovery.py).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: failed recovery must terminate with a specific diagnosis, not stay pending indefinitely
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Recovery classification is terminal and specific: permanent reconcile failures stay blocked with their diagnosis, transient failures are recorded and left to the existing reconcile sweeps without spending an attempt, per-event durable idempotence prevents repeated attempts, stale-HEAD binding is refused, and the bounded per-head budget exhausts with an explicit refusal; focused regressions prove each outcome (tests/test_hunter_reconcile_recovery.py).

defect_families.evidence: Recovery idempotence and budget are keyed to the durable checkpoint's (pull request, exact head, run) identity; a repeated event cannot replay an attempt, and execute_recovery refuses a head the live pull request does not carry.

The regenerated request is verified against local git evidence before it is written; review authority is never minted, copied or mutated by the refresh or recovery path, and the refreshed document carries no authority.
No new evidence store or connector surface: recovery records bounded events in one atomic local JSON checkpoint and reuses the existing writer review-finalization infrastructure.
Neither the finalizer nor recovery signs or pushes; publication remains the owner-bound signed writer channel, and no writer identity is accepted from candidate content.
The staged-content snapshot commit object is unreferenced plumbing that is never pushed; the review binds the exact staged tree instead of a stranded intermediate commit.
No receipt or authorization surface is touched: refresh and recovery mutate only .hunter/pre-ready-hostile-review.json, proven by focused regression.
The refreshed artifact remains a review request carrying no review authority; Ready still requires the trusted controller's exact-head review and owner approval.
Pending trusted prerequisites stay retryable: observation treats absence of exact-head failure evidence as no failure, and only the bound stale-request state is recoverable.
No prevention state is claimed by the candidate: the defect registry and its guards are unchanged, and recovery never publishes admission or readiness outcomes.
Recovery evidence is per exact head and event; a stale request recorded for a different head is never reused as proof for this one, and stale-HEAD binding is refused.
No runtime bootstrap or volume-aware issuer path is touched by this change.
No hosted execution ownership is touched: recovery performs read-only GitHub observation from the writer checkout and holds no execution authority.
No execution shutdown or drain path is touched by this change.
Merge readiness is unchanged: recovery never publishes readiness, statuses or PR state; it only re-requests review for current content through the existing finalizer.
No ledger claim or new execution entry point exists: recovery spends no hosted authorization and is not a privileged workflow.
The candidate still reaches GitHub only through the pre-push-gated signed writer channel; recovery performs no publication and no CI dispatch or rerun.
No tracked governance asset moved; the new module is loadable at scripts/hunter_reconcile_recovery.py and is imported by its regression tests.
Focused regressions inject GitHub evidence through seams and never assert live external preconditions inside the deterministic test lane.
The recovery CLI emits machine-readable JSON verdicts (planned/refused/attempt) from a closed refusal vocabulary with specific diagnoses.
No reviewer chain or timeout is touched: recovery never dispatches reviewers and never reruns CI.

The defect family itself: automatic exact-head request refresh after remediation plus bounded, idempotent, head-bound recovery removes the manual review-request rebuild loop; regressions cover stale refresh, wrong governing Issue, exact content binding, absence of fabricated authority, transient/permanent classification, duplicate-event idempotence, stale HEAD, budget exhaustion and publisher-candidate immutability.
